how: Two clients with distinct identities (sandbox-a, sandbox-b) from one sandbox against the real VM device. A took the lease; B asked with --no-wait and was refused naming sandbox-a; B enqueued the Metro smoke job, which waited in line behind A (queue position 1, status running while the worker waited for the lease); A released; B's job took the device and passed.
refusal: device busy: held by sandbox-a (position 1); retry with --wait
